description: Header file defining the 'flexible_o_du_pcaps' structure and a factory function 'create_o_du_pcaps' for creating and managing PCAP objects related to O-RAN DU, including signal handling and configuration-based creation.

classes.name: flexible_o_du_pcaps
classes.description: Structure managing various PCAP objects and their signal handlers for O-RAN DU.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets (closes and flushes) all PCAPs and signal handlers within 'flexible_o_du_pcaps'.

methods.name: create_o_du_pcaps
methods.description: Factory function that creates and configures PCAP objects based on provided configuration, including signal handlers for flushing.
